en.name: Discrete Mathematics 1 — Practice (Propositional Logic)
en.description: Guided learner workspace for the first practice of Discrete Mathematics 1: propositional logic explanations with worked examples, guided in-class tasks with an exit card, homework, and a subject-specific tutor guide for common misconceptions.
